exceptions.title: Exceptions
exceptions.subtitle: Everything that needs a human today
exceptions.noticeTitle: Red means blocked work, yellow means waiting
exceptions.noticeBody: A Mait at zero straws cannot record anything; a payment pending three days is still moving. The same rule holds in the app.
exceptions.s_failed-otps: Who is stuck, and which of the four things went wrong
exceptions.s_overdue-checks: Pregnancy checks nobody has walked, by Mait
exceptions.queueNoMatch: Nothing in this queue matches that.
exceptions.v_rebookedNo: No — a refusal closes the check
exceptions.g_pending-payments_not_authorised: The farmer has not entered her authorisation code, so nothing can move. Ring her, or ask the Mait to run the step again while he is with her.
exceptions.g_pending-payments_awaiting_proof: She authorised it and the money was sent online, but the Mait has not uploaded the UTR and the screenshot. Until he does there is no proof it arrived.
exceptions.g_pending-payments_awaiting_cash: She authorised it and the Mait has not confirmed the cash was handed over. Either it was not, or the second code was never entered.
exceptions.g_pending-payments_ready: Everything this mode needs has been collected and it is still pending. That is this platform's fault rather than anybody's on the ground — look at the record.
exceptions.g_failed-otps_attempts_exhausted: The code arrived and the wrong one was entered. They need a fresh code.
exceptions.g_failed-otps_never_attempted: Sent, and nothing was ever typed into it. Usually an SMS that did not arrive — check the gateway before the person.
exceptions.g_failed-otps_expired: Ran out of time part-way through. A fresh code is normally enough.
exceptions.g_failed-otps_superseded: Not a failure. They asked for another code and this one was retired to make way for it.
exceptions.g_failed-otps_open: Inside its window and may still succeed. Nothing to do yet.
exceptions.g_low-stock_at_zero: Cannot record an insemination at all until they are restocked. Anything they do in the field today is work this platform will have no record of.
exceptions.g_low-stock_running_low: Under the {{n}}-straw threshold and will run out mid-round. Raise an indent before they do rather than after.
exceptions.g_stale-indents_awaiting_approval: Sitting in this office, not at the depot. Approve or reject it; a Mait cannot chase what nobody has looked at.
exceptions.g_stale-indents_approved_not_issued: Approved here and not issued at the depot. This is the one to chase at the other end.
exceptions.g_overdue-checks_worst: Checks nobody has walked. Every one left undone is an insemination whose outcome this platform will never know, and a conception rate computed over the visits that happened to be convenient.
exceptions.g_overdue-checks_recent: Checks nobody has walked. Every one left undone is an insemination whose outcome this platform will never know, and a conception rate computed over the visits that happened to be convenient.
exceptions.g_declined-checks_repeated: A refusal closes the check for good — nothing re-books it — so each one is an insemination that will never get an answer. Repeated in one village it is a conversation with that collection point, not something the Mait can fix on their round.
exceptions.g_declined-checks_occasional: One or two refusals in a village is ordinary. Worth knowing rather than worth acting on — the check is closed either way and nothing re-books it.

rates.zeroTitle: A rate left at zero is not free
rates.zeroBody: It reads as unpriced, and the app tells the Mait to ask an administrator rather than quoting a figure the dairy cannot stand behind. That holds for the pregnancy rate as much as for the breeds. Every figure here reaches the handsets on their next request, and applies from then on — a visit already recorded keeps the price it was charged at, so re-pricing today never restates last month.

superOtp.title: Super OTP
superOtp.ruleTitle: Call the number on file. Never read a code to whoever rang.
superOtp.ruleBody: A code here stands in for an SMS that did not arrive — at sign-in, the farmer check, or a payment. It works once, for 10 minutes, for that step and the number shown. Dial that number yourself and read it to whoever answers. For a farmer step that is the farmer, never the Mait who asked: she tells the Mait the code, exactly as she would have read the SMS.

pipeline.title: OTP pipeline
pipeline.subtitle: Did the code reach the phone — and was the office right to be asked for one?
pipeline.ruleTitle: The gateway says accepted — never delivered.
pipeline.ruleBody: The SMS gateway confirms it took a message, not that a phone received it. So a code counts as arrived only when somebody typed into it, right or wrong. One the gateway accepted that expired with nothing typed, and was not replaced by a resend, is likely lost — the case Super OTP exists for.

pd.subtitle: Ninety days after insemination.

pd.subtitleLate_other: Ninety days after insemination. {{count}} are already late.

pd.remarkHint_pregnant: e.g. carrying well, body condition poor, owner told the calving month

pd.photoHint: Optional for a check, required if not pregnant
pd.saveFailed: Could not save this check. It is kept on the phone and will go in when there is signal.
pd.queuedBody: Goes in with the rest when there is signal.
pd.sentBody: The record is with the office.
pd.againBody: You are already here and she is in heat. This starts a new AI with the member and animal filled in — four steps instead of six.
pd.backToList: Not today — back to the list
pd.allDone: That was the last one this week
pd.recordedRecheck: A recheck was booked for 21 days later.
pd.cannotChange: A result cannot be changed here. If it is wrong, tell the office — the record keeps who wrote it and when.
pd.consentAsk: Will the owner allow the check?
pd.consentYesHint: Examine her and record what you find
pd.consentNoHint: She will not be examined today
pd.declineWhatHappens: Nothing is examined, nothing is recorded against her, and there is nothing to charge. The visit is logged as declined and the check is closed — you will not be asked about it again.
pd.recordedDeclined: The owner declined. Nothing was examined and nothing was charged.
pd.doneDeclinedBody: The refusal is on the record, so nobody will ask you why this check is still open. There is nothing left to do here.
pd.chargeMember: ₹ {{amount}} comes out of her milk payment
pd.chargeMemberHint: Nothing to collect in the yard.
pd.chargeUnpricedHint: Do not quote a figure. Tell the office the rate is missing.
pd.doneChargeMemberBody: Nothing to collect here. The dairy deducts it at the next payout.
pd.doneChargeNonMemberBody: Cash from the owner, before you leave the yard.
pd.doneChargeNoneBody: She was not examined, so there is nothing to collect and nothing to deduct.
pd.doneChargeUnpricedBody: The office has not set a price for this visit. Do not quote a figure; the record shows the visit was made.

route2.summaryLate: About {{time}} with the checks. The late ones first.
route2.noFix: No location yet — ordered from the first stop
route2.noStopsBody: Checks due this week appear here as a round.
route2.unplaced_one: {{count}} check has no recorded location and is listed last.
route2.unplaced_other: {{count}} checks have no recorded location and are listed last.
route2.reorderAsk: Shortest, or the late one first?
route2.reorderSubject: {{name}} is {{km}} km out and already late.
route2.reorderSubjectNone: Nothing is overdue, so the shortest order is usually the one.
route2.estimate: Distances are straight lines between where each animal was last served, scaled for winding roads — not road directions. The real ride is longer, and further where a river or canal has to be gone around. Worked out once when you tap Plan and held, so reordering offline uses the same figures.
route2.noMap: No map on this build — positions only
